backseat.autoStart.description: Start polling automatically when VS Code starts (if the bridge repo is detected).

backseat.clineCommand.description: Command used to invoke the Cline CLI for the fallback path (full path if not on PATH).

backseat.defaultTimeoutSec.description: Absolute cap: kill a running task after this many seconds (unless the task sets timeout_sec). Independent of activity — see backseat.inactivityTimeoutSec for the quiet-task timeout.

backseat.heartbeatSec.description: How often to push a heartbeat status to the bridge repo while a task runs.

backseat.pollIntervalSec.description: How often to pull the bridge repo and look for pending tasks.

backseat.preferClineApi.description: Try driving the Cline VS Code extension via its API first; fall back to the Cline CLI when the API surface is unavailable.

backseat.bridgeRepo.description: Your private bridge repo as "owner/repo" or a full git URL. The extension clones it to ~/.backseat/bridge and manages it automatically — Backseat then works in every VS Code window, no folder to open.

backseat.repoPath.description: Advanced override: explicit local path to the bridge repo clone. Leave empty to use the backseat.bridgeRepo managed clone.

backseat.notifyTopic.description: ntfy.sh topic for instant pings (optional). When set, the extension POSTs a notification on every task completion AND listens on the topic so new tasks wake it up in ~1s instead of waiting for the next poll. The topic is published to notify.json in the bridge repo so your Muse can discover it. Leave empty to disable; git polling still works.

backseat.inactivityTimeoutSec.description: While a task runs, time out when Cline shows no activity (no transcript growth, no CLI output, no project-repo commits) for this many seconds — even if timeout_sec has not elapsed. Resets on any activity. 0 disables (only the absolute cap applies).

backseat.lateWatchSec.description: After a sidebar-path timeout (Cline may still be working), keep watching the Cline session for a late completion for this many seconds, then revise the task record. 0 disables late watching.

backseat.checkpointMin.description: While a task runs, snapshot uncommitted project work to a backseat/<task-id> branch every N minutes (non-disruptive: branch, index and worktree untouched; ignored files excluded). 0 disables periodic checkpoints. Timeout checkpoints are controlled separately.

backseat.checkpointOnTimeout.description: On any task timeout, snapshot uncommitted project work to a backseat/<task-id> branch and push it, so a timeout can never strand Cline's work. Runs even when checkpointMin is 0.

description: Backseat-drive your Cline coding agent from your phone. Polls the bridge repo for tasks from your AI agent (Muse, Grok, or any agent that can use git) and runs them through Cline.
name: backseat
